P01.drivers: Thick, blocky trunk with a soft belly that sticks out in profile; wide waist with little taper; heavy thighs. Proportions and joints otherwise read as human.

P02.drivers: Rib cage is rounded and barrel-like, bulging both at the chest and at the upper back in profile, then narrows sharply to a pinched waist. Below the waist there is a separate rear bulge. Limbs are long and thin, with bulbous calves and knobby knees. The way the sections are shaped and joined is unlike any human build in the set, not just a thin version of one.
axial_cues: rounded rib cage bulging front and back in profile

P03.drivers: Slim, average human build with normal taper and proportions.

P04.drivers: Average human build with slightly fuller hips.

P05.drivers: Average human build with a slightly soft belly and normal buttocks.

P07.drivers: Slim human build with relatively wide hips and thighs. Within normal variation.

P08.drivers: Somewhat stocky human with broader thighs and fuller buttocks. Still ordinary.

P09.drivers: Same arrangement as P02: a rounded rib cage that bulges at chest and back, a pinched waist, a separate rear bulge at the hips, thin limbs and bulbous calves. The front view shows a narrow, tubular trunk with sloped shoulders.
axial_cues: rounded rib cage bulging front and back in profile

P10.drivers: Broad-shouldered, athletic human with a V-taper. Not extreme.

P11.drivers: Wide, boxy trunk with little waist and a full belly in profile; heavy thighs. Very similar to P01. Human joints and proportions.

groups.label: heavy, overweight human builds with boxy trunk and protruding belly
rounded rib cage, pinched waist, slender limbs with bulbous calves (distinct body plan)

distinguishing_features: Only one non-human group is visible: P02 and P09. In profile it is set apart by a rib cage that bulges at both chest and back, a waist that narrows abruptly, a separate bulge at the pelvis, long thin limbs and bulbous calves. P01 and P11 are heavy humans, not a separate race. They could possibly be read as a stocky race, but their joints and segment proportions look human, so I classed them B for fatness.
